money.name: Moneys
money.about: A run's Moneys: wild prizes and trainers. Pays for healing and run shops; turns into Research when the run ends.

research.name: Research
research.about: What a run brings home. Spent on the Lab's unlock board.

scrap.name: Scrap
scrap.about: The building material. A little for every place a run reaches, and salvage from the Bureau's bots; spent at the ranch and the Workshop.

dna.name: DNA
dna.about: Splicing's currency (SP-3): banked the moment a spliced wild Billie is beaten. The Gene Bank spends it.

crests.name: Crests
crests.about: Rare: one for beating a run's boss. Spent at Skyline Station.

beans.name: Beans
beans.about: Rare finds on runs. Hub folk love them as gifts; nobody says why.
